question: How many customers are in the database?
How many orders were placed in the first half of 2025?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date < '2025-07-01';

question: Which product sold the most units?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT 1;

question: How much revenue came from the Electronics category?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE p.category = 'Electronics';
